name: Hosts Inspector Finding
description: An account's footprint in one region hosts an Amazon Inspector v2 package-vulnerability finding (footprint -> finding): one inspector2:ListFindings returned for the run's account, ACTIVE or CLOSED in the last 30 days, each read to its end unless the credential's findings_max_per_region or findings_read_budget_seconds trims it. Containment, parent -> child: the footprint declares this edge in CONTAINMENT_EDGES, and the reader records that footprint's account_region.inspector2_findings surface, filtered, so never complete. Inspector has no detector-like parent resource, so the footprint holds its findings. Collected by the landing-zone reader's Inspector half (collectors/boto3_collector/inspector.py, aws-core-tap#261).
